541856.name: Rohr Chabad Jewish Center
541856.note: The Pittsburgh Jewish Chronicle (on CrownHeights.info, 11 Dec 2013): 'For the last six years, the living room in the small, Morgantown, W.Va.' home of the Gurevitzes served as the Chabad House; 'It was Rosenfeld who assigned the Gurevitzes to Morgantown six years ago' (so 2007). Its listing went up Aug 6 2007, which agrees. Medium: a count back.

1174865.name: Chabad of Altoona
1174865.note: Chabad.org (on CrownHeights.info, 23 Aug 2010): Rabbi Yossi and Chanale Stein 'last month opened the Chabad-Lubavitch Jewish Center of Greater Altoona' (July 2010). Its listing went up April 2 2010. Rabbi Shneur Horowitz directs it now.

2021440.name: Tzohar Seminary for Chassidus and the Arts
2021440.note: Chabad.org (on CrownHeights.info, 10 Nov 2011): 'the Tzohar Seminary for Chassidus and the Arts, opened its doors this fall in Pittsburgh, Pa.'

4808845.name: Chabad of Cranberry Township and Butler County
4808845.note: Lubavitch.com (13 Oct 2020, 'New Shluchim bring Jewish community to Pittsburgh suburb'): 'In late June of this year Rabbi Yossi and Leah Feller, new Chabad emissaries to Cranberry Township in Pennsylvania, met Kevin Bartko'; they held the High Holidays in an outdoor tent. Its listing went up Sept 9 2020.

6589811.name: Beis Medrash Chabad of Pittsburgh
6589811.note: CrownHeights.info (18 Aug 2024): 'Bais Medrash Chabad Pittsburgh Expands Campus with Acquisition of Two Buildings for the Inaugural Year' (its first year, 2024-25; a new hanhala member announced April 2024). Its listing went up Oct 1 2024.

704343.name: Chabad of Carnegie Mellon University
704343.note: The Pittsburgh Jewish Chronicle (on CrownHeights.info, 13 Aug 2008): 'After years of sharing a Chabad House with the surrounding universities, students at Carnegie Mellon University will have one of their own'; Rabbi Shlomo and Chani Silverman 'are opening up the first Jewish organization with a staff solely devoted to Jewish students at CMU'. Its listing went up July 21 2008.
